verdict.rationale: Visa ships an official open-source Agent Toolkit (TypeScript) with published npm package (@visaacceptance/mcp, v0.0.96), integration with Vercel AI SDK, and MCP server support, plus a separate public GitHub repo for the Trusted Agent Protocol reference implementation with runnable components. Docs, quick-start guides, and REST API references (instructions, tokens, credentials) round out an SDK-like developer experience. missing for 10: independent third-party developer reviews/tutorials showing real-world SDK usage, and broader language coverage beyond TypeScript.
